lines_of_business: Health benefit plans administered by Cigna Companies; some markets use delegated vendor guidelines
criteria_location: Coverage Policy, pp.2-4 only. Pages 4-27 are evidence review; 28-38 references.
procedures_covered: Topical oxygen therapy A4575 (covered for DFU)

logic.top_level: pathways (three lists: first-line, adjunctive, not medically necessary; TOT separate)
logic.exclusions_or_contraindications: Explicit NMN list of ~45 conditions ('ANY of the following conditions'). Not a default-deny as FL is, though TOT 'not medically necessary for any other indication'.

and_or_ambiguity.quote: considered medically necessary first-line treatment for ALL of the following conditions
and_or_ambiguity.why_ambiguous: Capitalized ALL means each listed condition qualifies, not that a patient needs all; literal parsing as 'all' is wrong.

and_or_ambiguity.quote: considered not medically necessary for ANY of the following conditions
and_or_ambiguity.why_ambiguous: ANY here is a NOT over each condition.

requirement_kinds.quote: acute carbon monoxide poisoning; air or gas embolism; decompression sickness; exceptional blood loss when transfusion is not an option

requirement_kinds.where: Coverage Policy p.2 (first-line vs adjunctive label)

requirement_kinds.quote: Wagner grade III or higher diabetic wounds/ulcers of the lower extremities that have failed standard wound therapy
idiopathic sudden sensorineural hearing loss (ISSHL) within four weeks of symptom onset
thermal burns, acute, requiring inpatient hospitalization
acute cyanide poisoning, after administration of antidote
Topical oxygen therapy (TOT) ... diabetic foot ulcer that has failed to heal with optimal standard of care

thresholds.quote: within four weeks of symptom onset

time_windows.quote: within four weeks of symptom onset

codes.codes_tied_to_criteria: CPT/HCPCS 'Considered Medically Necessary when criteria in the applicable policy statements listed above are met'; TOT A4575 tied to the DFU criterion.

external_dependencies.what: delegated vendor guidelines in certain markets
external_dependencies.quote: In certain markets, delegated vendor guidelines may be used to support medical necessity

definitions_that_change_meaning.definition_quote: preexisting grafts or flaps that are showing signs of failure or necrosis

vague_terms.problem: no duration, no definition of standard therapy

vague_terms.quote: osteomyelitis unresponsive to conventional medical and surgical interventions
exceptional blood loss when transfusion is not an option

vague_terms.problem: labels with no different criteria attached

extraction_hazards: Criteria are 3 pages inside a 39-page document dominated by evidence review
Bullets split across a page break (p.2/p.3)
Two lists use ALL/ANY in caps with meaning opposite to the logical reading
Revision Details table records changes (TOT moved to covered 9/15/2025, avascular necrosis 5/15/2025)
interesting_structures: Covers topical oxygen for DFU, unlike FL
Two-tier label first-line vs adjunctive without extra criteria
Only payer with an NMN list for pressure ulcers, venous stasis ulcers, COVID-19

fit_to_tree.scale: 1 = all/any/not expresses it cleanly ... 5 = needs new constructs
fit_to_tree.why: Pure any-of list; one leaf pair (Wagner III+, failed standard therapy) for diabetic wounds. Difficulty is the capitalized ALL/ANY and undefined 'failed'.
